title: Recommendations and considerations related to preparticipation screening for cardiovascular abnormalities in competitive athletes: 2007 update
claims: The 2007 AHA scientific statement is the source of the 14-element pre-participation screening recommendation for competitive athletes.
The statement recommends targeted personal history, family history and physical examination, with further evaluation when any element is positive.
The statement does not recommend routine 12-lead ECG as a mandatory screening test for all competitive athletes.
